key_features: Complete Lunch Set for On-the-Go：Our kids bento lunch box includes everything you need for your meals: multi-compartment bento box, stainless steel insulated food jar, stainless steel folding spoon, sauce cup and dividers. The lunch box is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Perfect for school, traveling or picnics.

Creative Bento Box: Our bento box for kids has unique raised buttons and realistic shapes that give it a distinctive look. The cool shape makes kids have more fun with this lunch box！(No boring flat printing)

Multi Compartment Design: Our lunch box have dividers and dip cups, and removable dividers allow you to customize the compartments for sandwiches, fruit, snacks, or regular meals. Individual sauce cups won't allow sauce to spill onto other foods and meals will be more flavorful! The perfect kids lunch box for school, traveling or picnics!

9 OZ Stainless Steel Insulated Food Jar: The exclusive spoon storage compartment on the lid of the insulated food jar keeps your folding stainless steel spoon neatly organized so you don't have to worry about forgetting to bring a spoon. The insulated food jar in our lunch box set also has a built-in vent button to prevent pressure buildup and make it easy to open.

Easy-Clean & Durable Construction: Our insulated food jar and bento box are dishwasher safe, saving time, while the BPA-free, drop-proof material stands up to daily use. Reinforced pins are safe and child-friendly.
